observations: A dark, bulky figure sits upright at center, its wide-open mouth showing teeth and its head ringed by a bright white oval above; yellow line-work traces the body's edges against a purple-teal torso.
The lower half is filled with loose white and cream circular looping forms on a blue-lavender ground, suggesting foam or cloud without defining either precisely.
Upper left holds a large soft yellow disc bleeding into orange and gold; the background shifts from warm yellow-gold on the left to muted rose-brown on the right.
reading: A heavy dark figure sits amid billowing white loops, its wide-open mouth and red-tinged eye giving the face an unsettled charge. A bright white oval above the head reads as both possible light source and ironic marker—brightness pressed against something rawer below. Yellow line-work crackles across the dark mass, and the warm solar disc at upper left pulls against the cooler blue ground, keeping the mood hard to settle.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, the layered warm-cool sky and soft cloud-foam ground here contrast sharply with the flat teal field and spare black silhouette of title-neighbor nnxyz nnotb #64, showing the tonal range the collector values.

connections.reason: Both works center a dark open-mouthed form with yellow line-work, but #64 strips the image to a flat silhouette on solid teal while #65 layers the same elements into a dense atmospheric ground.
Title-neighbor #66 shares the soft circular cloud ground and yellow scribble lines over a dark animal body, making the two a close formal pair within the owned nnotb subset.

lookingQuestion: Where does your eye move first—toward the white oval above the head, the open mouth, or the warm disc at upper left—and what does that path do to how you read the figure's weight?
ambiguities: The white oval above the head reads as a halo by convention, but its form could equally be a light reflection or floating ring; no metadata confirms the subject identity.
